title: LMS Implementation Consultants (Senior & Junior)
description:
LMS Implementation Consultants (Senior & Junior)


  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Hiring Type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) – Independent Contractor | Monthly Invoicing


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a leading edtech services company specializing in the design and delivery of impactful e-learning experiences that empower learners and drive organizational growth. We partner with global leaders such as Google, AWS, Microsoft, VMware, Meta, and Coursera to deliver world-class technical education programs. Many of our solutions include immersive, hands-on labs that help learners build practical, job-ready skills at scale.


As our Learning Technology practice continues to grow, we are expanding our LMS implementation capability to support enterprise clients globally.


Senior LMS Implementation Consultant

We are seeking an experienced Senior LMS Implementation Consultant to join our Learning Technology team. This role is ideal for a seasoned consultant with strong hands-on experience implementing and configuring enterprise LMS platforms.


While experience with Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD) is highly desirable, we will provide full training and certification. We welcome applications from experienced LMS implementation consultants with expertise in platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Moodle, Docebo, Totara, Oracle Learning, or similar enterprise LMS solutions.


You will act as a trusted advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle—working closely with clients to design scalable learning solutions, lead configuration activities, and ensure successful adoption of the LMS platform across diverse organizations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end LMS implementations, enhancements, and platform optimizations
  • Act as subject-matter expert across LMS functionality including user structures, curricula, certifications, permissions, integrations, and reporting
  • Translate business and learning requirements into scalable system configurations
  • Design learning architectures aligned with organizational and compliance goals
  • Advise clients on LMS best practices, governance models, and release updates
  • Provide advanced troubleshooting and post-go-live support
  • Develop and maintain high-quality configuration and process documentation
  • Collaborate with project management, instructional design, and technical teams
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to continuous improvement of delivery standards


Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on LMS implementation or consulting experience
  • Proven experience delivering LMS solutions for mid-sized or enterprise organizations
  • Strong understanding of LMS concepts (curricula, certifications, user management, roles/permissions, reporting, integrations)
  • Experience with data migrations, imports/exports, and system integrations
  • Strong client-facing and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Professional, consultative approach with the ability to lead workshops and guide decision-making


Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)
  • Experience with enterprise LMS platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors Learning, Workday Learning, Docebo, Moodle, Totara, or Oracle Learning
  • Familiarity with SCORM, AICC, xAPI
  • Experience in HRIS, talent management, or L&D transformation programs


Junior LMS Implementation Consultant

We are also hiring a Junior LMS Implementation Consultant to support the delivery of LMS implementation projects. This role is suited to professionals with early experience in LMS administration, system configuration, or SaaS implementation who are looking to develop into a senior consulting career path.


Full training will be provided on Cornerstone OnDemand and other enterprise LMS platforms. We welcome candidates with experience across a range of LMS systems or related SaaS platforms.


You will work closely with senior consultants to configure systems, support clients, and contribute to successful implementation outcomes.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support LMS configuration and implementation activities
  • Assist with requirements gathering and documentation
  • Configure user structures, learning items, assignments, and reporting under supervision
  • Support data uploads, testing cycles, and user acceptance testing
  • Provide post-go-live support and basic troubleshooting
  • Develop user guides and configuration documentation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams


Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–3 years of experience in LMS administration, SaaS implementation, or similar system-based role
  • Familiarity with LMS concepts such as users, courses, curricula, certifications, and reporting
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow structured implementation processes
  • Good communication skills and a client-focused mindset
  • Eagerness to learn and develop in a consulting environment

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, , e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub

  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)

Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js / React Native / TypeScript)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with 5+ years of professional front-end development experience using React.js, React Native, and TypeScript for our U.K. / U.S. client. You will design, build, and maintain high‑impact user interfaces — from customer dashboards and data visualizations to our React Native mobile app.

Our client is a nature data and intelligence company on a mission to drive large-scale nature recovery. They combine data, science, and technology to help enterprises value and restore nature, creating measurable environmental and economic impact.


Responsibilities

  • Own front-end delivery for key product surfaces across web and mobile taking features from technical feasibility through technical design, implementation, release, and iteration
  • Build and evolve UI foundations including component patterns, design-system primitives, reusable layouts, and interaction standards that keep UX consistent as the product scales
  • Translate product and design intent into clear, intuitive user flows sweating the details on information hierarchy, micro-interactions, accessibility, and polish
  • Ship performant, data-heavy interfaces in Next.js / React.js, with strong attention to perceived performance (e.g., loading states, empty states, progressive disclosure, and responsiveness)
  • Contribute meaningfully to the React Native app, delivering cross-platform UI and shared patterns where it makes sense, while handling platform-specific edge cases when needed
  • Use automated testing to ensure the UI quality, stability, and performance
  • Partner tightly with Product, Design, and Tech Lead to scope work into thin, shippable increments, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and keep delivery moving without sacrificing quality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of professional experience building production, front-end applications with React.js and TypeScript
  • Experience building and supporting cross-platform, React Native features in a production application
  • Strong eye for UI and UX quality, paying close attention to interaction behavior, information hierarchy, accessibility, and polish
  • Proven experience implementing and operating within a component library / design system (e.g., tokens, reusable components, consistency, and documentation) in close collaboration with Design
  • Strong fundamentals in state management, responsive design, and performance optimization including perceived performance (e.g., loading states, skeletons, optimistic UI, and smooth interactions)
  • Comfortable taking ambiguous product requirements and turning them into clear UI flows, iterating quickly with stakeholders, and owning outcomes
  • Shareable portfolio or examples of UI work (e.g. links, screenshots) as well as the ability to explain what you personally owned and enhanced
  • Proactive mindset and the ability to self-manage in a distributed environment
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment


Desired Experience

  • Experience with mobile release workflows (App Store / Play Store), build tooling, and troubleshooting React Native native-module / platform-specific issues
  • Experience with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Recharts) and/or map-based UI (e.g., Mapbox)


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal Solution Architect
description:
Step into a strategic leadership role where your ideas shape the future of cloud data innovation. Join a fast‑growing Snowflake and cloud‑native consulting partner as the Senior Director of Data Engineering for LATAM. You’ll lead high‑impact data initiatives, guide technical strategy for key accounts, and elevate engineering excellence across the region. This remote position allows you to connect with teams from Brazil and Mexico while driving impactful data initiatives that propel business growth.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead Regional Data Engineering: Manage and mentor teams across LATAM, fostering innovation, growth, and consistent technical excellence.
  • Own Technical Delivery: Oversee end‑to‑end solution delivery for strategic accounts, ensuring high‑quality, scalable Snowflake and cloud data platforms.
  • Drive Strategy & Growth: Partner with Sales and executive stakeholders to identify opportunities, expand services, and deliver long‑term customer value.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Provide clear, actionable guidance on modern data architectures, cloud-native patterns, and platform maturity.
  • Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Work closely with teams in Brazil, Mexico, and global delivery to ensure alignment and successful outcomes.
  • Uplift Talent: Coach engineers, architects, and account teams in both technical depth and communication excellence.
  • Extreme Ownership: Proactively solve complex challenges, ensure accountability, and champion customer success.


What Makes You a Great Fit:


  • Proven record of high‑performance delivery in complex cloud data environments.
  • Strong ability to simplify technical complexity and influence architecture decisions.
  • Customer‑obsessed , entrepreneurial, and proactive approach to driving outcomes.
  • Inspiring leader who grows people, builds trust, and elevates team capabilities.
  • Thrives in a fast‑moving, rapidly scaling consultancy supporting Snowflake and cloud ecosystems.


Required Experience:


  • 10+ years as a hands‑on Solutions Architect or Data Engineering leader.
  • 2+ years consulting leadership with external clients.
  • Expertise designing and delivering production-grade solutions across Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, or Databricks.
  • Strong Python, SQL, and experience building scalable pipelines and integrations
  • Demonstrated success managing Data Engineers and Solution Architects across distributed teams
  • Prior Revenue Generation experience for Enterprise clients.
  • Experience shaping technical strategy, roadmaps, and long-term customer partnerships
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client-facing presentation skills
  • Ability to create detailed technical artifacts (POCs, roadmaps, architecture docs, diagrams)
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field preferred


Technical Strengths (One or More):


  • Cloud data platforms: Snowflake, AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks
  • Storage & distributed systems: S3, ADLS, HDFS, GCS, NoSQL stores
  • Data integration: Spark, Kafka, Streamsets, Matillion, Fivetran, NiFi, ADF, DMS, IICS
  • Multiple data source ingestion: APIs, databases, files, queues
  • Automated transformation: dbt, Spark, streaming pipelines
  • Orchestration: Airflow, Managed Airflow, Luigi, NiFi
  • Methodologies: Agile, Kimball, Data Vault

title: Engenheiro de sistemas sênior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) System Engineer Sênior com experiência em ARCHER e ambientes Cloud (Azure e AWS), para atuar no planejamento, engenharia e sustentação da infraestrutura de sistemas da organização.

O(a) profissional será responsável por upgrades, versionamentos, rotinas de manutenção e por garantir a estabilidade, performance e evolução dos ambientes tecnológicos.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, implementar e projetar infraestrutura de sistemas (hardware e software)
  • Executar upgrades, versionamentos e rotinas gerais de manutenção
  • Monitorar performance e disponibilidade dos sistemas
  • Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos de comunicação entre sistemas
  • Identificar necessidades técnicas das áreas e propor direcionamentos estratégicos
  • Analisar requisitos de usuários e produzir documentação técnica (fluxogramas, diagramas, etc.)
  • Atuar em projetos de alta complexidade
  • Liderar iniciativas técnicas e apoiar na gestão, treinamento e mentoria de outros membros do time


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência comprovada como System Engineer
  • Conhecimento em ARCHER
  • Experiência com Cloud (Azure e AWS)
  • Sólido conhecimento em:
  • PCs e hardware de rede
  • Sistemas operacionais
  • Softwares corporativos
  • Protocolos de comunicação de rede
  • Experiência em diagnóstico e resolução de problemas complexos de sistemas


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência liderando projetos técnicos
  • Vivência na mentoria e desenvolvimento de equipes


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa

The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week.   • Help manage social media platforms and support community engagement
  • Contribute to PR initiatives, including drafting press releases and coordinating with media partners
  • Brainstorm fresh ideas for brand awareness and digital campaigns
  • Support administrative and marketing tasks as needed


What We’re Looking For:

  • Skills in graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

Nosso time é movido por desafios, inovação e aquele brilho nos olhos de quem sabe que tá fazendo história. Já pensou fazer parte de algo gigante assim? 

Aqui, sua carreira pode crescer tanto quanto a gente. Bora?

O mundo é movido por pessoas que fazem acontecer. 

Fazer acontecer é uma maneira de viver. 

Uma maneira de fazer negócios. Uma maneira de realizar.

Reagimos rápido. Nos adaptamos às mudanças. 

Traçamos metas audaciosas e partimos para a ação. 

É nisso que acreditamos. Essa é a nossa essência.

Chegamos até aqui porque cremos em nossos resultados e no nosso propósito de descomplicar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma liderança forte, visão audaciosa, cultura inspiradora e uma equipe composta de pessoas incríveis, formamos uma empresa pungente que pensa no coletivo. 

Afinal, se um ganha, todos ganham.

Nossa ambição é grandiosa. 

E possível.


Prazer. Somos o Chaves na Mão.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.

We are looking for an experienced L2 Support Analyst to provide functional production support for enterprise Contract Management Software (CMS/CLM) platforms. This role focuses on incident resolution, configuration support, and close collaboration with business users and technical teams to ensure system stability and efficient contract operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Level 2 production support for Contract Management Software platforms, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Analyze and resolve issues related to:
  • Contract templates, clause libraries, and fallback logic
  • Workflows, approvals, and business rule configurations
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract type setups
  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring functional and configuration-related issues.
  • Support minor enhancements and functional configuration changes (non-code).
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues and coordinate with Level 3 technical teams when required.
  • Manage user access, role assignments, and permission-related issues.
  • Execute approved data corrections, metadata updates, and configuration fixes.
  • Support UAT and regression testing for fixes and minor platform updates.
  • Maintain support documentation, knowledge articles, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate closely with L1 support teams, business stakeholders, and L3 technical teams to ensure timely issue resolution.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience providing production support for Contract Management Software (CLM/CMS) platforms (e.g., Icertis, Coupa CLM, DocuSign CLM, SAP CLM, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with functional configurations, including:
  • Contract templates and clause libraries
  • Workflows, rules, and approvals
  • English (B2- Fluent)
  • Metadata, attributes, and contract types
  • Solid understanding of contract lifecycle management processes .
  • Experience working with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS applications in complex or regulated environments.
  • Exposure to system integrations with ERP, CRM, or document management platforms.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-based support models or Agile delivery environments.

UST is waiting for you!

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems

  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field

title: Digital Ad Designer
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.

Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.

The Role

As a Digital Ad Designer at Lilo Social, you will create scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns while designing high-converting landing pages that drive measurable results for DTC brands. You will collaborate closely with creative strategists and media buyers to translate performance insights into compelling visual creative that captures attention and converts browsers into buyers.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent improvement in creative performance metrics (CTR, conversion rate, thumb-stop rate) across your client portfolio
  • Fast iteration speed that enables creative variations per week with maintained quality standards
  • High client satisfaction through on-brand designs that align with strategic creative direction
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration that accelerates testing velocity and produces scalable winning concepts

Responsibilities

  • Design high-performing static graphics for Meta ad campaigns across feed, stories, and reels formats
  • Create conversion-focused landing pages that align with ad messaging and drive customer action
  • Execute on creative briefs provided by strategists, translating concepts into visually compelling designs
  • Iterate quickly based on performance data, A/B test results, and stakeholder feedback
  • Maintain brand consistency and visual standards across multiple client accounts simultaneously
  • Design mobile-first experiences optimized for Meta's platform specifications and best practices
  • Organize and manage design files, asset libraries, and version control using established naming conventions
  • Collaborate with media buyers to understand campaign objectives and creative testing priorities
  • Stay current on Meta platform trends, ad formats, and direct response design principles
  • Produce landing page designs that integrate seamlessly with existing brand systems and conversion frameworks
  • Participate in creative reviews and provide design rationale grounded in performance marketing principles
  • Adapt existing creative concepts into new formats, sizes, and placements efficiently

Requirements

  • 3-4 years of design experience in performance marketing, advertising, or DTC ecommerce
  • Expert proficiency in Figma for design collaboration and file organization
  • Strong command of Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop and Illustrator)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response creative and performance-focused design work
  • Proven experience designing ads specifically for Meta (Facebook and Instagram)
  • Understanding of mobile-first design principles and responsive layout techniques
  • Demonstrated ability to iterate quickly while maintaining high quality standards
  • Experience designing landing pages with conversion rate optimization in mind
  • Organized approach to file management with attention to naming conventions and version control
  • Comfort working with performance feedback and data-driven design decisions
  • Strong communication skills and ability to articulate design decisions
  • Self-starter mentality with ability to manage multiple client accounts and deadlines

Nice to Have

  • Motion graphics or animation skills with proficiency in After Effects or similar tools
  • Experience with landing page builders (Unbounce, Instapage, Replo, Shogun)
  • HTML/CSS knowledge for basic landing page customization
  • Understanding of Meta Ads Manager and campaign performance metrics
  • Experience working in an agency environment with multiple simultaneous client accounts
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce product page design
  • Knowledge of direct response copywriting principles and how they inform design hierarchy
  • Experience designing for additional platforms (TikTok, Google Display, YouTube)

Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere with flexible hours and a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Computer Vision & Machine Learning
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – Computer Vision & Machine Learning

Location: Brazil (remote)

Contract: PJ (long-term)

We’re looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to join our Inbound team and build highly scalable machine learning solutions that power item attribute detection (e.g., color, material, style) and merchandise authenticity verification.

If you’re passionate about solving real-world business problems using state-of-the-art Computer Vision and ML techniques — and enjoy taking ownership from research to production — we’d love to connect.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and deploy Computer Vision and Machine Learning solutions to solve high-impact business challenges
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, efficient, and scalable production-grade code
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to extract insights and drive data-informed decisions
  • Apply state-of-the-art ML methodologies (CNNs, Transformers, GANs, etc.) to build robust models
  • Lead the technical direction of key components and systems
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Tech Leads to deliver deployable solutions
  • Mentor team members and help grow domain expertise
  • Contribute to technical leadership through patents and publications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in Computer Vision and Applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s or PhD in CS, ML, Statistics, or related field (or 8+ years of industry experience)
  • 3+ years building, deploying, and managing ML/DL models in production at scale
  • Deep understanding of ML/CV techniques: CNNs, Transformers, GANs, optimizers, regularization
  • Strong experience with experiment design, A/B testing, training/serving pipelines, and feature engineering
  • Proficiency in Python and scientific libraries (NumPy, Pandas)
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn)
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with experiment automation tools (Ray Tune, Weights & Biases, Kubeflow)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, OR, or related field
  • Experience applying ML to real-world retail problems
  • Familiarity with MLOps pipelines and tools
  • Strong ownership mindset with a focus on measurable business impact

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.

We need tutors who can start immediately!

Characteristics

Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite

Requirements

  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

About LatinHire

Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: PESSOA COORDENADORA DE CIÊNCIA DE DADOS - REMOTO
description:
Descrição da vaga

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Entre as marcas que compõem o nosso grupo estão Anglo, PH, Plurall, Líder em Mim e outras. Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. Valorizamos a autonomia e o apoio, o bem-estar, a excelência, a liderança e a inovação em nossa rotina de trabalho. Somos o único grupo educacional classificado como uma das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar, Great Place to Work – GPTW.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

- Coordenar a equipe de tecnologia, garantindo a qualidade e integridade das informações;

- Realizar análise de dados, utilizando técnicas de Business Intelligence e Data Mining;

- Gerenciar o banco de dados e implementar soluções de Big Data;

- Liderar projetos de análise de dados e extração de insights;

- Resolver problemas relacionados à manipulação e interpretação de dados;

- Promover a comunicação eficaz entre a equipe e demais áreas da empresa.

Requisitos e qualificações:

- Graduação em Ciência da Computação

- Pós-graduação em Análise de Dados

- Certificação em Big Data

- Experiência comprovada em análise de dados e gestão de equipes

- Conhecimento em estatística e técnicas de Machine Learning

- Habilidade de liderança, trabalho em equipe e adaptabilidade

- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e resolução de problemas

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.

Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Conexa: Atendimento psicológico gratuito para cuidar da sua saúde mental.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.

Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About Able

Able is the AI front office for Wholesale Plumbing, HVAC, and Electrical Suppliers. We're automating the soul-crushing manual work that buries inside sales teams - starting with fixture quoting.

The Wholesale Supply market is a $350B+ market running on spreadsheets and tribal knowledge. We're building the infrastructure to change that.

About the Role

Founding Engineer, with a focus on shipping Agents. You'll spec features, debug weird edge cases, scale infrastructure and help us figure out what to build next based on what customers actually need.

We're not looking for someone who needs a roadmap handed to them. We're looking for somebody who wants to help build the roadmap. If you see a problem, you fix it. If you don't know something, you learn it.

What we're looking for

  • 3 to 5 years of Software Engineering experience
  • Backend depth — you're comfortable owning a Python/FastAPI service end-to-end, from async request handling to data modeling to production debugging
  • Agent & LLM Fluent - you understand how agentic systems work and the failure modes that arise
  • Cloud comfortable - GCP, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Vercel, & Docker. You don't need to be an infra specialist but you shouldn't be scared of it
  • Document intelligence - comfortable working with document parsing & extraction pipelines (OCR, layout analysis, structured extraction, etc)

You're Likely a Fit If

  • You've designed, built, and shipped something with LLMs or Agents with real users
  • You're comfortable making decisions and backing up your logic
  • You default to shipping over planning. Iteration > Perfection
  • You've worked in an early-stage company before and are ready for the chaos
  • You're a tinkerer - also playing around with new technologies or projects

What You'll Do

  • Work with the Founding team to collect user feedback, design feature specs, implement updates, and deploy to production
  • Work across the stack: Python/FastAPI, Next.js/Typescript, Firebase, Docker, GCP, etc
  • Debug production issues and make them obsolete
  • Build and improve agent workflows using home grown frameworks
  • Help shape the product roadmap
  • Stay up to date on modern agent architectures/improvements and implement where
  • necessary

Want some Bonus Points?

We've set up an MCP server at ` - candidates who know what to do with it will find something useful

title: Executive Search Consultant
description:
About Gold & Aron:

Gold & Aron Conseil is a boutique executive search firm with a 20+ year track record of placing top-tier talent in the Technology and Financial Services industries across the Americas and Europe.

About the Role

We are hiring an Executive Search Senior Associate to support Gold & Aron CEO and COO across high-impact searches in Technology and Financial Services in a premium boutique environment. The role blends deep research, pipeline development, and end-to-end recruiting for select mid-level roles. You’ll help build the engine that enables leadership to focus on client strategy and firm growth.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Candidate Research & Sourcing for senior level searches (60%)

  • Build and manage strong candidate pipelines across multiple concurrent searches.
  • Active search: Conduct structured research, market mapping using several tech tools including Linkedin, AI tools and own data base.
  • Passive search: Source, screen applicants
  • Lead candidate scoring, initial candidate assessment

End to end Recruiting for selected mid level searches (30%)

  • Build and manage candidate pipeline
  • Conduct first-round screens to assess fit and motivation.
  • Prepare concise candidate summaries and search updates.
  • Support client communications and progress check-ins.
  • Coordinate interviews and every other step of the hiring process.

Business Development Support (10%)

  • Research companies, markets, and potential clients
  • Build prospect lists and market intelligence for the CEO and COO.
  • Bring new ideas, new BD initiatives for the company

IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • 3–7+ years in research, consulting, finance, tech, recruiting, or similar fields.
  • Experience in or recruiting for Tech or Financial Services is a strong plus.
  • Advanced English + Native Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a strong plus.
  • Analytical, structured thinker with strong organization and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity; bias for action; strong ownership mindset.
  • Bachelor’s degree mandatory.
  • Location: Brazil remote. Preference for São Paulo, SP.

title: Service Technician
description:
Description

The Service Technician should be responsible to provide Aftersales support for Brazil, working from home. He/she is responsible for providing remote support, technical training for partners and on-site service when necessary. The person should be available for business trips and understand the electric and photovoltaic (solar) standards and requirements for Brazil.

Please do not apply if you do not meet the requirements!

Responsibilities

  • Handle general inquires for technical support and after sales related activities;
  • Training partners to provide daily technical support to customers over phone line, email, or face to face;
  • Solve / handle technical escalations from the customers;
  • Provide technical advice for local distributors, installers and end users;
  • Provide minor on-site inspection, commissioning, troubleshooting and replacement of defectives products, with appointments of customers in advance;
  • Keep track of in-out of replacements units;
  • Perform firmware upgrading and minor reworks in hardware locally when necessary;
  • Maintain frequent communication with management staff in Brazil;
  • Maintain a good communication with Level 2 engineers based in HQ office, in China;
  • Attend exhibitions and marketing events and introduce products and solutions;
  • Submit the related reports and documents to supervisor every week;
  • Be available during work hours, from Monday-Friday, between 8-12h and 13:30-18h.

Required Skills

  • Intermediate Chinese for speaking and writring;
  • Technical degree in electricity, Photovoltaics, Renewable Energy or other comparable course;
  • Advanced knowledge of PV Inverters (on-grid and storage);
  • At least 1 year of experience with PV inverters;
  • Experience with DG (Distributed Generation);
  • Basic knowledge in sizing electrical circuits, PV arrangement, protection circuits, and interpretation of electrical diagrams;
  • Knowledge about Brazilian regulation on PV;
  • MS Office.
  • English speaking

Optional Skills (If you have them, it’s a Plus!)

  • Spanish speaking;
  • Experience with PV Large Utility-Scale;
  • Experience with lead-acid and lithium batteries for PV storage systems;
  • Zendesk experience;
  • NeoCRM experience.

Attributions

  • Excellent organization skills with the ability to quickly assess priorities;
  • Proactivity, sense of urgency, team work;
  • Independence (work without direct supervision);
  • Availability for business trips in Brazil.

title: Remote Senior Java Developer
description:
Required Skills & Experience:

- 5 to 10 years of experience as a backend engineer within a Java environment

- Java version 17 and above

- GCP experience (will consider Multi Cloud experience - AWS, Azure)

- Interest in working with modern tools & Technologies

- Open-source Java framework experience (Quarkus preferred but Spring is okay)

- Microservices experience

- Terraform experience

- Able to work in a very fast paced environment

- Experience and willingness to be testing your own code

Nice to Have Skills & Experience:

Golang

Job Description:

Our client is looking for Senior Back End Java Engineers to join their team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and documenting the back-end services for their mobile app and website while coaching and mentoring junior resources and collaborating with other team members and stakeholders. You will also drive best practices, ensure the technical feasibility of integrations, and optimize the application for maximum speed, scalability, and reliability. You will investigate and utilize Google Cloud Platform services to continuously improve application architecture and implement microservices using Java and Quarkus framework. You will propose and enhance automation initiatives related to infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting and contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle. This is an established company and environment with a startup feel so you must be able work in a fast-paced environment and used to timelines that are in days instead of weeks. This role is fully remote and long term.

The salary for this position is between 274,517BRL - 329,421.45BRL.

Please apply if you are interested in learning more and we can set up a time to speak further!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (.NET + Kubernetes + AI Accelerated Development)
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.

Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns

What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.

Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives on using the latest and greatest backend technologies including .NET 10 and cloud-native patterns .

This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.

Our Backend Tech Stack

You’ll be working with a modern, cloud-native environment that includes:

  • .NET , .Net Core + EF (latest)
  • MySQL - primary transactional database
  • Amazon Redshift - analytics & reporting
  • Valkey (Redis) - high-performance caching
  • Kubernetes on AWS - service orchestration & scaling
  • Heavy use of AWS native services across compute, networking, messaging, and storage
  • Azure DevOps - CI/CD pipelines, deployments, automation
  • Microservices architecture following modern design patterns

What You Will Do

  • Build production-grade backend services using .NET 10 , .NET Core, and the latest EF features.
  • Design, build, and support microservices that are scalable, resilient, secure, and cloud-native.
  • Work across MySQL, Redshift, and Valkey (Redis) to support both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Deploy and operate services in Kubernetes on AWS.
  • Own CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows in Azure DevOps .
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code with a strong emphasis on unit testing and automated testing culture (TDD).
  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and AI teams to deliver features end-to-end.
  • Use AI-powered tools for code acceleration, debugging, test generation, refactoring, and documentation.
  • Contribute to shaping long-term system architecture with a path toward becoming a Solutions Architect / Principal Engineer .

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Strong backend experience with .NET / C# , and comfort with modern runtime features.
  • Experience with .NET Core , Entity Framework , and cloud-native backend development.
  • Solid understanding of microservices architecture , distributed system patterns, and clean coding principles.
  • Strong experience with unit testing and testable architecture.
  • If candidates cannot demonstrate real unit testing experience or passion, this role is not a good match.
  • Skilled in debugging, profiling, and optimizing backend systems.
  • Fluent English, comfortable with daily video-based communication.
  • Ability to work a full U.S. Pacific Time schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Redshift or other analytical database systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS native services (SQS, SNS, Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, etc.).
  • Experience with high-scale SaaS, data-heavy systems, or AI/ML integrations.
  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD), event-driven patterns, or CQRS.

Who You Are

  • A self-motivated engineer with a passion for modern backend engineering.
  • Someone who enjoys working with the latest technologies , not legacy stacks.
  • A team player who cares about quality, testing, architecture, and long-term impact.
  • A builder who wants to grow into an architect and drive technical excellence.
  • A problem solver who takes ownership and thinks beyond task-level execution.
  • A strong believer in AI-accelerated development and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building high-scale backend systems from the ground up. You’ll have the opportunity to define architectural foundations, build mission-critical services, and grow into a senior technical leader. Our stack gives you the chance to work with cutting-edge .NET technology, real cloud scale, and ambitious product challenges.

If you’re passionate about backend engineering, love modern .NET, and want to become a future architect, we’d love to talk.

title: England Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.

Role Description

We are seeking an experienced English Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into English markets, with a strong understanding of English business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.

Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be responsible for:

- Developing and maintaining relationships with English cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within England's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in English cosmetic packaging markets

Qualifications

- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with English cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of English cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to England as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: UI/UX Designer (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote UI/UX Designer with 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design to to partner closely with the Product and Engineering teams to elevate usability, visual consistency, and user experience across the platforms of our U.S. client. You will work 10 hours per week in a hands-on role supporting new feature design, workflow improvements, and visual system enhancements across the SaaS products. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in B2B software environments, translating product requirements into thoughtful user experiences, and collaborating with crossfunctional teams.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Design intuitive user experiences for complex SaaS workflows and data-heavy applications
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to shape feature concepts and interaction patterns
  • Apply and extend existing design systems and component libraries
  • Conduct lightweight user research or usability testing when needed
  • Iterate quickly based on stakeholder feedback and technical constraints
  • Ensure designs align with accessibility and usability best practices
  • Prepare assets and specs for smooth handoff to engineering

Requirements

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 6+ years in UI/UX or Product Design, with significant experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end design work on data-intensive systems (dashboards, tables, grids, reporting tools, multi-step workflows)
  • Experience designing for multi-role environments with interconnected user workflows
  • Experience collaborating closely with product and engineering to navigate technical constraints and trade-offs
  • Proficiency with design tools
  • Familiarity with design systems and component-driven product development
  • Ability to work independently within a limited-hours engagement
  • Clear communicator who can explain design decisions to technical and non-technical partners

Desired Expereince

  • Bachelors degree in computer science or engineering
  • Experience in energy, finance, accounting, or other regulated/operational industries

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack .Net + React
description:
Código da Vaga: 58095

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em .NET e React

Projetar, implementar e manter soluções baseadas em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Gerenciar e otimizar infraestrutura em AWS (EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, etc.);

Desenvolver integrações e fluxos assíncronos utilizando RabbitMQ ou Kafka e outras soluções de mensageria;

Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB); Garantir boas práticas de segurança,

Conhecimento em containers (Docker, Kubernetes);

Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.

Contratação CLT + Hibrido no Rio de janeiro 3 dias.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
